copy.html:
What is the EuroMillions lottery?

Want to win big in one of the largest lotteries on the planet? EuroMillions lottery is the game for you! In the past jackpots have hit a massive €190 million, and as of February 2020 this is set to rise to an even better €200 million! Draws are held in Paris every Tuesday and Friday at 21:00 CET (20:00 GMT).

Can I Play EuroMillions lottery online?

Yes! LottosOnline makes playing EuroMillions lottery simple. To buy a ticket simply login to your account, choose EuroMillions lottery and select your lucky numbers. If you prefer random numbers, the Quick Pick number selector will make the decision for you. How you play is entirely up to you.

What is the cut-off time for purchasing EuroMillions tickets on LottosOnline?

EuroMillions lottery tickets must be purchased before 18:00 CET on the day of the draw, so approximately three hours before the draw takes place.

Can I still play EuroMillions from outside Europe?

Yes! You can play right here on LottosOnline. It doesn't matter if you live outside of Europe, you can play the largest big-money lotteries from across the globe right here at LottosOnline.

How do I claim the money on LottosOnline if I win the jackpot?

Regardless of the amount, winning the lottery is an incredible feeling! LottosOnline makes claiming EuroMillions prize money simple. After winnings are confirmed, smaller winnings will reflect in your LottosOnline Winnings Balance. Players can use the transfer option to convert the funds to credit in their Account Balance, or they can use the claim option to get our agents to transfer the funds to a bank account! All the latest EuroMillions results are published on the LottosOnline results page. If you are a jackpot winner, get ready for an amazing adventure! We will be in touch to discuss your collection of the winning ticket. All you need to do is write your shopping list.

What is the EuroMillions Superdraw?

The EuroMillions Superdraws are special lottery draws held throughout the year. Players are offered a minimum jackpot of €100 million. If there are no jackpot winners, the jackpot will roll over to the next scheduled draw.

How do I win the EuroMillions lottery?

Winning the EuroMillions jackpot is simple, all you need to do is match the five main numbers as well as the two Lucky Star numbers. There are 13 prize payout tiers. This makes your chance of winning prize money 1 in 13!
